headings.rules: Use for all H1-H3. Tight letter spacing (`tracking-tight`). Never use generic sans for headings. Emphasize elegance with font-light or font-medium.

body.rules: Use for all body text, buttons, and UI elements. Ensure high legibility with generous line-height (`leading-relaxed`).

colors.rules: Avoid pure black and pure white where possible (except for cards). Use the Soft Beige (#FDFBF7) as the canvas. Gold (#C5A059) is for primary actions and elegant accents.

surfaces.cards: Highly rounded corners (`rounded-3xl`). Soft ambient shadows (`shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]`). 1px delicate border (`border-[#E8E6E1]`).
surfaces.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers and floating action buttons. `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/40 shadow-sm`. NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds where text readability is at risk.
surfaces.buttons: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`). Primary buttons use Gold background with White text and a subtle shadow (`shadow-md shadow-[#C5A059]/20`). Secondary buttons use White background with Gold border and Gold text.
surfaces.inputs: Minimalist. `bg-transparent border-b border-[#E8E6E1] rounded-none focus:border-[#C5A059] focus:ring-0` OR fully rounded pill-shaped inputs with soft `#F4EFE6` backgrounds.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use 2-3x more spacing than default. E.g., `p-8` to `p-12` for card padding, `gap-8` or `gap-12` for grids. Let the content breathe.
layout_and_spacing.guest_upload_page: Mobile-first, full-height (`min-h-screen`). Centered, emotional typography. Large, inviting dropzone for uploads spanning almost full width. Keep steps minimal: Scan -> Enter Name -> Tap to Upload.
layout_and_spacing.dashboards: Clean sidebar with Gold active states. Grid layout (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6`) for metrics. Use 'Bento Grid' style for the Bride & Groom gallery view.
layout_and_spacing.gallery: Masonry layout for photos. Subtle hover state to slightly dim the image and show a 'favorite' heart icon.

motion.rules: Smooth, deliberate animations. Use Framer Motion for page transitions (`opacity: 0` to `opacity: 1`, `y: 10` to `y: 0`). Micro-interactions on buttons (scale down slightly on tap). Staggered entrance for gallery images.

components.upload_zone: A large area with `bg-white/50`, soft rounded corners (`rounded-3xl`), and a dashed border (`border-2 border-dashed border-[#C5A059]/30`). On drag hover, change border to solid Gold and background to `#F4EFE6`. Include a prominent, elegant upload icon.
components.gallery_grid: Masonry or balanced Bento grid. Images should have `rounded-xl` and a subtle hover effect (zoom slightly with `scale-105` inside a hidden overflow container).
components.timeline_view: Vertical line with dots. Elegant spacing. Dates in small serif, events in sans-serif.
components.shadcn_overrides: Override Shadcn's default sharp edges. Add `rounded-3xl` or `rounded-2xl` to dialogs and cards. Change ring colors to Gold. Do not use default Vercel styles.
components.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (`@phosphor-icons/react`) with 'light' or 'thin' weight for an elegant touch.

images.rules: Use these strictly for the landing page placeholders, login backgrounds, or default state avatars. Never use placeholder services.

general_instructions: NEVER use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto. Use Cormorant Garamond for headings and Manrope for body.
The guest upload page must feel like a premium invitation. Scan -> Enter Name -> Tap to Upload.
Apply `data-testid` to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
Install and use Phosphor Icons (`yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`). Use the 'light' weight.
Do not use dark backgrounds. The theme is light, minimal, luxury. White, Gold, Soft Beige.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications, styling them with a light background, soft beige text, and gold border.
Use Shadcn UI but heavily customize the classes to use rounded corners (`rounded-3xl`) and our color palette.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft ambient shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate. ALWAYS ensure backgrounds under glassmorphism are not entirely transparent.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
